comment: Boards to fetch. 'ats' selects the adapter, 'slug' is that ATS's board identifier, 'tier' is the fit tier from Job_Search_Profiles.md section 10. Every entry below was verified on 2026-08-29 by reading the board's actual postings - not merely by the endpoint returning 200. Reachability is not identity: a live board can belong to a different organisation of the same name, or contain a vendor's demo data. See 'rejected' below for the ones that failed that check.

sources.note: Ecosia's real board, confirmed 2026-08-29 from ecosia.org/about/careers. Rev 3's correction was backwards: it found this board empty, assumed the slug was wrong, and switched to personio 'ecosia' - which is an unclaimed account serving demo data. An empty Ashby board is reported as a problem each run, which is the correct loud behaviour. Re-checked 30 Aug 2026 after the watchdog fired twice: ecosia.org/about/careers links to this exact board and it is genuinely empty, so `verified_empty` silences the watchdog for 30 days and then makes it ask again - a slug can still rot later. Note Ashby 404s unknown slugs, so unlike SmartRecruiters a 200 here does mean the board is real.
14 postings, all Berlin, climate project management. Best single addition - Projektmanager Klimaschutzprojekte and Trainee on the Job sit directly on profile 1.
Berlin/Bottrop/Bern. Editorial roles - profile 3 and 4 territory.
Berlin + Madrid think tank. Currently one speculative posting only - a real board, thin.
Berlin. One open-application posting - real, just not hiring today.
Berlin social-impact consumer brand. NOT the ashby 'share' board, which is a telecoms company - see rejected.
Climate. Large international board; Berlin roles present but a minority, so expect volume before filtering.

The Foundation, not Wikimedia Deutschland (Berlin), which is on a different system and still unfound. Its postings give location as a bare 'Remote' with no country, so HARD_LOCATION_NONEU cannot fire and 12 of them reach scoring every run - mostly US-based. Demoted to Tier E rather than deleted: it is a genuine Tier-1-sector employer that does occasionally hire in Europe. Revisit if the scoring cost of 12 low-probability postings per night is not worth it.
Closes one of the eleven no-feed entries from rev 3. Berlin, but currently engineering and IT only.

rejected.comment: Boards that returned 200 with well-formed postings and are still not usable. Recorded rather than deleted so nobody re-adds them from a probe next month.
rejected.personio:wwf-deutschland: UNCLAIMED Personio account, not WWF's board. WWF Deutschland publishes vacancies on its own site (wwf.de/ueber-uns/stellenangebote/stellenangebot/stelle/<slug>) and uses no ATS at all - so no Personio slug will ever be theirs. Rev 3 read this board's three demo postings as WWF's real hiring and built the 'coverage != reachability' principle partly on it.
rejected.personio:adelphi: UNCLAIMED Personio account, not adelphi's board. adelphi DOES use Personio, on the custom domain careers.adelphi.de (job URLs look like /de/jobposting/<hash>/apply). See pending_egress - that host is not on the whitelist yet.
rejected.personio:ecosia: UNCLAIMED Personio account. Ecosia is on Ashby at 'ecosia.org' - see sources.
rejected.personio:greenpeace: Personio ONBOARDING SAMPLE DATA. Three postings: General Application, SEO Marketing Manager (London), Social Media (Working Student). Identical set to personio:storytel with different posting ids - a real but unconfigured Personio account. pipeline.sample_board_reason() now blocks this class.
rejected.personio:storytel: Same Personio sample data as greenpeace.
rejected.personio:germanwatch: Personio sample data, German locale: Initiativbewerbung (Festanstellung), Social Media (Werkstudent), Teststelle.
rejected.personio:dgap: Personio sample data, German locale, offices given as Muenchen.
rejected.ashby:share: A different 'share' - telecoms, Nairobi/London/Netherlands. The Berlin share is on Recruitee.
rejected.greenhouse:tomorrow: Tomorrow.io, weather/defence, Tel Aviv and US. Not Tomorrow the Hamburg sustainable bank.
rejected.lever:ashoka: Genuinely Ashoka, but the global board: Bangalore, Jakarta, Arlington, Milan. Ashoka Deutschland (Berlin) does not publish here. Worth a separate hunt.
rejected.smartrecruiters:springernature: Genuinely Springer Nature, but all six postings are Pune, India. Their Berlin hiring is published elsewhere.

linkedin.comment: The only aggregator source. Cards carry no description, so pipeline.py fetches bodies ONLY for postings that survive the card-level rules - see fetch_linkedin/enrich_descriptions. Automated access is against LinkedIn's terms and the account at risk is the candidate's own, so the caps below are deliberate and should stay low. Tier E because LinkedIn surfaces mostly corporates and agencies (Deloitte, Instaffo, Arup in the first ten results), which sit at the bottom of the Section 1 ranking - it needs a higher score to surface.

pending_egress.comment: Real boards we cannot reach yet because the host is not on the org egress whitelist. Adding the host is a one-line change in claude.ai -> Organization settings -> Capabilities -> Code execution.

adelphi.note: Personio lets a customer serve the board from their own domain, so the *.jobs.personio.de whitelist entry does not cover it. The container currently gets 403 at the proxy, not from adelphi. Once whitelisted, try https://careers.adelphi.de/xml with the existing Personio adapter.

no_public_feed.comment: Probed 2026-08-29 (two rounds) against Personio, Greenhouse, Ashby, Recruitee, Lever and SmartRecruiters. Recorded explicitly rather than dropped - a watchlist entry that fails quietly is worse than one marked unreachable. Three of these were opened in a session and confirmed to have NO machine-readable feed at all, which is typical of small German NGOs and think tanks - i.e. exactly the candidate's best-fit segment. Reaching them needs an HTML careers-page diff adapter, not a better slug.

confirmed_no_ats.WWF Deutschland: No ATS. Vacancies are pages on wwf.de itself (ueber-uns/stellenangebote/stellenangebot/stelle/<slug>). Needs the HTML careers-page adapter.
confirmed_no_ats.Hertie School: Vacancies listed on-page at hertie-school.org/en/jobs; research and faculty applications go by email to researchandfaculty@hertie-school.org.
confirmed_no_ats.GPPi: Openings are ordinary articles on gppi.net (e.g. part-time researcher, critical technologies, 14 Aug 2026). Applications by email, PDF only.
confirmed_no_ats.Hot or Cool Institute: No posted openings by default; open application by email to work@hotorcool.org. Index is hotorcool.org/work-with-us/, not /jobs/.

corrections.Ecosia: The handoff listed Ashby slug 'ecosia.org'. That board exists but is empty. Ecosia is actually on Personio as 'ecosia'.
corrections.Sastrify: Personio slug 'sastrify' returns a valid but empty board. Dropped - Tier E anyway.
corrections.Dataiku: Dropped. Tier F, and every posting was US or France sales/engineering.
corrections.SmartRecruiters probing: api.smartrecruiters.com/v1/companies/<anything>/postings returns 200 with totalFound 0 for slugs that do not exist. All twenty feedless-org probes 'succeeded' on it. For that ATS only postings > 0 is evidence a slug is real.
